title: Quantum Broker: QoS-Aware Distribution of Quantum Computations
abstract: arXiv:2610.28342v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cloud-accessible quantum computing has made heterogeneous Quantum Processing Units (QPUs) available through provider platforms that differ in qubit technology, calibration state, queueing behavior, and pricing model. This heterogeneity makes execution management a quantum-engineering concern: a quantum circuit may be executable on several backends, but the resulting cost, latency, fidelity, and reproducibility depend on backend selection and on how measurement shots are allocated. This paper presents the Quantum Broker, an open-source and provider-agnostic framework for Quality-of-Service-aware quantum execution management. The framework operationalizes shot-wise distribution by exploiting the statistical independence of quantum measurement shots to dispatch a single circuit across multiple heterogeneous QPUs according to user-defined constraints and optimization objectives. translated_title: 量子代理：服务质量感知的量子计算分发
translated_abstract: 云端可访问的量子计算使得异构量子处理单元（QPU）能够通过提供商平台获得，这些平台在量子比特技术、校准状态、排队行为和定价模型上各不相同。这种异构性使执行管理成为量子工程需要关注的问题：一个量子电路可能可以在多个后端上执行，但由此产生的成本、延迟、保真度和可重复性取决于后端的选择以及测量射击（shots）的分配方式。本文提出了量子代理，这是一个开源且与提供商无关的服务质量感知量子执行管理框架。该框架通过利用量子测量射击的统计独立性，根据用户定义的约束和优化目标，将单个电路分发到多个异构 QPU 上执行，从而实现了按射击粒度的分发。该框架结合了模块化执行架构、可互换的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了开源且与提供商无关的 Quantum Broker 框架，利用量子测量射击的统计独立性，根据用户定义的服务质量约束和优化目标，将单个量子电路按射击分发到多个异构 QPU 上执行。
en_tdlr: The Quantum Broker is an open-source, provider-agnostic framework for QoS-aware quantum execution management that exploits the statistical independence of measurement shots to distribute a single circuit across multiple heterogeneous QPUs according to user-defined constraints and optimization objectives.
